resale_co.name: Certificate of Continued Occupancy - Residential (Certificate of Zoning, Smoke Detector, Carbon Monoxide, Fire Extinguisher Compliance)
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Wood-Ridge Zoning Official and Fire Prevention Official (one combined application)
requirements: No open permits; owner certifies permits were issued for all alterations
Room inventory by floor, which the Zoning Officer compares with tax records, permits and variances
Smoke detector on each floor including the basement (and finished attic), within 10 feet of each bedroom, attached with screws
Carbon monoxide detector within 10 feet of each bedroom
ABC fire extinguisher (at least 2A:10B:C, no more than 10 lbs) in or within 10 feet of the kitchen (form still lists it)
Certification of Payment of Taxes signed by the Wood-Ridge Tax Collector
Payment by cash or check to the Borough of Wood-Ridge; credit cards not accepted

fees.label: Owner-occupied transfer of one-family dwelling (Borough code)
fees.quote: Owner-occupied transfer of one-family residential dwelling: $75.

fees.label: Owner-occupied transfer of two-family dwelling (Borough code)
fees.quote: Owner-occupied transfer of two-family residential dwelling: $100.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Certificate of Continued Occupancy / Zoning Compliance - Residential application (seller, buyer, attorneys, realtor and a room inventory), attach the Certification of Payment of Taxes signed by the Tax Collector, and file it with cash or a check to the Borough of Wood-Ridge at the Construction Code Office, Municipal Building, 85 Humboldt Street, second floor. Call 201-939-5188 for inspections.
resale_co.contact_title: Zoning Officer (Construction Code Official: Chris Cunningham)

evidence.quote: The seller is required by order of Borough Ordinance #530-88 and N.J.A.C. 570-4.19 to obtain
these documents prior to the sale or rental of any residential unit structure.
No open permits exist for the property
And (2) the attached Certification of Payment of Taxes form filled out and signed by the Wood Ridge Tax Collector
Owner-occupied transfer of one-family residential dwelling: $75.
Certificate of Continued Occupancy/Zoning Compliance - Residential
Please call 201-939-5188 to schedule your inspection.

resale_co.notes: The njwoodridge.org site now redirects to woodridgenj.gov and its pages load by script, so they were read through a text reader. Borough Code 530-88 was read through the ecode360 print view; it sets the CCO fees but its wording (530-88A) only clearly requires a CCO before reoccupancy of a vacated building 'other than an owner-occupied residential structure.' The Borough's residential form says the seller must get the certificate before any sale or rental, so it is treated as required. The form also covers the smoke/CO certificate (see fire certificate). No phone or email for the Zoning Officer specifically is posted; the Construction Office line and email are used.

requirements: Smoke detector on each floor including the basement (and finished attic), within 10 feet of each bedroom on that floor
Carbon monoxide detector within 10 feet of each bedroom
Detectors attached to the ceiling or wall with screws; double-sided tape is not acceptable
ABC fire extinguisher at least 2A:10B:C, no more than 10 lbs, in or within 10 feet of the kitchen (form still lists it)

authorities.name: Wood-Ridge Fire Prevention Bureau (smoke/CO inspected under the Borough's combined Certificate of Continued Occupancy - Residential)
authorities.how_to_apply: Use the Borough's Certificate of Continued Occupancy - Residential application; it is a combined zoning and smoke/CO/fire extinguisher application signed off by the Zoning Official and the Fire Prevention Official. No separate smoke certificate fee is published.

evidence.quote: Certificate of Zoning, Smoke Detector, Carbon Monoxide, Fire Extinguisher
The Fire Prevention Bureau is headed by Fire Official John Kurz.

fire_cert.notes: Wood-Ridge folds the smoke/CO certificate into its residential CCO application ($75 single family, $100 two family). No separate fire fee or days-before-closing tiers are published. The form still requires a fire extinguisher, which the state dropped from the sale certificate in February 2025 (P.L.2025, c.19). Fire Official phone and email are from the NJ DCA fire directory (survey 2/27/2026); the email uses the old njwoodridge.org domain.

other_items.label: Paid taxes
other_items.detail: The CCO application must include a Certification of Payment of Taxes signed by the Wood-Ridge Tax Collector.

other_items.label: Open permits
other_items.detail: No open permits may exist for the property; the owner certifies that permits were issued for all alterations.

open_questions: Does Wood-Ridge still require the fire extinguisher at resale after P.L.2025, c.19?
How far ahead of closing should the CCO be requested, and is there a re-inspection or rush fee? None is published.
Is there a separate Fire Prevention Bureau fee for the smoke/CO part of the CCO?
